leaves.Text: Take these Leaves Of Tanacetum Parthenium. A Molokh still has the ambergris I need. Kill one and return; I will finish the mixture. {spawn AK01 1}{completequest AO26}

molokh.Text: The Molokh still lives. Bring that problem to an end, then come back.

mix.Text: The ambergris and leaves will do. Take this Soothing Mixture to One Who Gives Warnings at the Hourglass, 2544 by 980. {spawn AK03 1}

after.Text: One Who Gives Warnings is at the Hourglass.
